context_compaction.note: `/compact` manual compaction and packages/ai/src/cache/compaction.ts exist; summarize inferred from those.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Per-tool line caps (bash 80 · read 300 · grep 120), ANSI strip, blank-line collapse
observation_format.note: Image tool results are tested in packages/ai but no shipped screenshot tool is shown.

tool_count.note: The default tool list is not included in the evidence; the MCP server exposes Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write, and memory and Task tools also exist.

tool_schema_source.note: The schema-producing code is not in the evidence; MCP clients exist.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP transports: stdio · Streamable HTTP · in-process. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE; tokens in OS keychain.
protocol_standardization.note: The file packages/agent/src/mcp/acp.ts suggests ACP is supported.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Ralph-style autopilot. Rolling state, per-iteration $/token ledger, shadow-git checkpoints, ranked termination
loop_primitives.note: The default is the interactive agent loop; the goal loop and YAML recipes are opt-in.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Model sees only `read`/`grep`/`find`/`ls`, produces a written plan, never edits. Subagents inherit the gate. `/act` to execute.
planning_granularity.note: The plan is saved and executed via `/act`; plan mode is opt-in.

multi_agent_topology.note: A Task tool can spawn subagents, which makes an orchestrator_workers topology reachable; it is unclear whether that is the default.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Subagents — up to 7 parallel, worktree-isolated. Frontmatter agents at `.cave/agents/*.md` (Claude Code superset). Five ship by default.

human_in_loop.note: The comparison table implies permission prompts exist and that autopilot disables them. Plan mode is gated ('/act to execute'). README prose only; no line numbers are available. It is unclear which mode is the default.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Persistent memory delegated to [cavemem](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/cavemem) (MIT, hybrid BM25 + local vectors).
long_term_memory.note: Skills are loaded from ~/.cave/skills; episodic to semantic consolidation is documented.

self_verification.note: No harness verification code is in the evidence; a critic agent file exists and bench verify.sh is eval-only.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: ranked termination (sentinel · iteration cap · $-cap · no-progress · SIGINT)
termination_condition.note: These conditions apply to the goal loop.

cost_controls.note: The $-cap applies to the goal loop; the architect/editor split and router.ts provide routing.

execution_isolation.note: Docs claim a native sandbox (Seatbelt/Landlock) but the default is not shown; a Docker image is also available.

permission_model.note: The default mode is unclear; autopilot mode needs no prompts.

tracing.evidence_quote: JSONL sessions in `~/.cave/agent/sessions/`, organized by working directory.
